environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in VPC (subnet-0a1b2c3d) as part of Step Functions state machine 'DataPipelineOrchestrator'. Lambda has IAM role with s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::pipeline-results-prod/*. VPC has NAT gateway for outbound internet access. S3 access goes through NAT gateway (no VPC endpoint configured). Step Functions workflow accepts input from API Gateway with basic API key authentication. The internal config server (config.internal.company.com) is a Route53 private hosted zone resolving to an internal ALB that can be configured to return 302 redirects.
